technical.summary: Mixed technicals with overbought conditions and weak trend confirmation; momentum indicators bullish but volume and cloud positioning suggest limited upside probability.

fundamental.summary: AIG shows no actionable smart money signals with zero insider activity, no institutional positioning data, absent government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 15 days present material risk.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (23/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but mixed congressional activity (1 small purchase vs 2 sales) and absent news sentiment provide insufficient conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession, VIX at crisis levels (333.4), strong dollar pressures financials, and earnings binary event in 15 days compounds risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme fear sentiment (23/100) with contrarian buy signal and supertrend bullish confirmation offer asymmetric risk/reward if macro stabilizes post-earnings.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis, strong dollar), high earnings binary risk in 15 days, overbought technicals with weak trend confirmation, and price below 200-EMA create compounding downside catalysts.
